=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py:line 947 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: A leading slash makes the first-segment check inspect an empty string, allowing a loop variable in the first endpoint path segment to bypass the guard.
  WHY: This violates the restriction against loop-variable expansion in the first path segment; severity is critical (Minimax), while other reviewers rated it high.
- .claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py:lines 247-248, 883-886 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: `GITHUB_TOKEN` and `GITHUB_`-prefixed variables are not excluded as loop counters, allowing an approved loop to overwrite GitHub CLI credentials or configuration.
  WHY: Bash preserves exported-variable attributes across loop assignments, so the counter can affect authentication or the API endpoint; severity is critical (Minimax), while other reviewers rated it high or low.
- .claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py:line 1061 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The loop candidate check accepts only a literal space after `for`, although the loop parser also accepts tabs.
  WHY: Tab-separated read-only loops without `gh api` are short-circuited before loop validation and receive no decision; severity is high, while some reviewers rated it low.
- .claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py:lines 254-257, 953-965 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The read-command flag allowlist accepts `--repo` but omits its `-R` shorthand.
  WHY: Read-only loops using `-R` are rejected by the flag parser and receive no decision; severity is high, while some reviewers rated it low.
- .claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py:lines 957-964 | severity=low | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The flag parser does not recognize `--flag=value` syntax for supported read-command options.
  WHY: Such options fall through as unknown flags, so otherwise valid read-only loops receive no decision; reviewers rated this low or NIT.
- agents.md:lines 1160-1164 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The permissions guidance does not document the new literal-ID read-loop exception and says loops are left to the normal permission flow.
  WHY: This contradicts the guard behavior and updated `CLAUDE.md` guidance; severity is high (Minimax), while other reviewers rated it low.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
